payload.title: File:Dryosaurus Scale.svg
payload.description_html:
Size comparison of the Jurassic North American ornithopod dinosaur Dryosaurus elderae. Based on a skeletal reconstruction by Greg Paul. Human silhouette 180 cm from File:Silhouette of man standing and facing forward.svg.

References:

  • Carpenter, Kenneth; Galton, Peter M. (2018). A photo documentation of bipedal ornithischian dinosaurs from the Upper Jurassic Morrison Formation, USA. Geology of the Intermountain West. 5: 167–207.
  • Paul, Gregory S. (2016) The Princeton Field Guide to Dinosaurs. 2nd ed. Princeton University Press.
